subject: My export keeps failing
body: Every time I try to export my workspace it fails partway through. I've tried a few times. What should I do?
notes: The solver produces a weak answer the critic keeps rejecting, so the pipeline retries up to the budget, re-running retrieval, solving, guardrail, and critic each pass. Cost, latency, and tool-call count balloon, and the ticket still ends up escalated. Demonstrates why a per-request cost and retry budget is not optional.
